videos.title: Skills in LLM? #ai #systemdesign #anthropic #trenuri
videos.description:
Skills in AI : the one concept that’ll make your prompts smarter 🧠

Ever wonder how AI tools like Claude “remember” the way you like things done, without you explaining it every single time?

That’s called a Skill.

📌 Definition:
A Skill is a saved set of instructions that an AI reads only when a task needs it, so you don’t repeat yourself every time.

📌 Example:

You tell Claude once: “Whenever I ask for a LinkedIn post, keep it under 150 words, start with a question, and end with ‘Thoughts?’”

Save it as a Skill.
